comment: Every SDK that ships in this repository, and the CI gate that blocks a
release when it breaks. There is no tier field and there is no tier: if an
SDK is in ReproIt it is fully supported, which means its own suite runs on
every push and a failure fails the build. sdk/check-inventory.py refuses a
declaration that has drifted from that.
`gate` is a list of literal strings that must appear in
.github/workflows/ci.yml. At least one of them must name the SDK's own
directory, so an entry cannot be satisfied by some unrelated step. This is
a wiring check and is stated as one: it proves the invocation is present
and blocking, not that the assertions inside it are good. The assertions
are proven by the suites themselves.
`runs` is the human sentence for what that gate executes. It exists so a
reader can tell at a glance whether the whole suite runs or a subset does,
which is the drift that produced this file: seven SDKs had no CI mention
at all and four more ran only some of their test files.

reproit-android.runs: the pure-Kotlin core suite on the host JVM, then validates the emitted batch

reproit-backend-dotnet.runs: the full xunit project (trace, capture, instrument, e2e, canonical JSON, vectors)

reproit-backend-go.runs: go vet plus go test ./..., which includes the e2e and behavior-vector tests

reproit-backend-java.runs: mvn test, which runs all seven JUnit classes including the behavior vectors and the capsule parity suite

reproit-backend-node.runs: every file under test/, e2e included (express and fastify devDependencies)

reproit-backend-php.runs: each of the seven test scripts, one php process per file

reproit-backend-py.runs: every file under tests/, e2e included (the e2e dependency group)

reproit-backend-rb.runs: each of the six test files in its own ruby process; see the note in ci.yml

reproit-backend-rs.runs: clippy and tests with the instrument feature, which the default build never compiles

reproit-ios.runs: swift test over the whole ReproItTests target

reproit-linux.runs: all seven suites under tests/, including causal, invariant, and protocol

reproit-react-native.runs: jest over every file under test/, plus build, typecheck, and pack

reproit-recorder-node.runs: the recorder suite (bounds, correlation ids, transport refusals)

reproit-tauri.runs: the JS plugin suite: behavior vectors and the document-start transport

reproit-tui-go.runs: go test ./..., which includes causal, invariant, and reporter

reproit-tui-py.runs: all five suites under tests/, including causal, invariant, and protocol

reproit-tui-rs.runs: cargo test on the package by name, not incidentally via the workspace

reproit-tui-ts.runs: node --test over all four suites: parity, vectors, causal, invariant

reproit-windows.runs: the full ReproIt.ParityTests project, then packs both NuGet packages

reproit_flutter.runs: flutter test for the package and for the example fixture app, plus analyze and pack
